title: Goodreads Review Completion Lag
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:review shelf=* finished_epoch=* review_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((review_epoch-finished_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by shelf
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures review completion lag by shelf for Goodreads reviews.
value: Lag tracking shows which shelf create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside Goodreads reviews.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `review completion lag` on `reading:review` events and aggregate them by `shelf`.
visualization: Table of shelf with average and worst review completion lag.
grandmaExplanation: It records how long things take for each shelf so you can see where Goodreads reviews slows down.
